safeToShare.description: The decision: whether a share may go ahead with this booking. True for RESERVED, REBOOKED, SHARED, SURPLUS and UNLISTED - progression places SURPLUS and UNLISTED from its own record - and for UNKNOWN, where the check failed open. Act on this, not on status.

status.description: Where the booking is. With a hold or listing: RESERVED, SHARED, or REBOOKED (the hold had expired and, because the request set reserveIfExpired and the session still had room, courtscheduler took it again under the same id). With nothing held, why: SURPLUS (a share merged its line onto another booking's session), UNLISTED (its listing was freed, e.g. by a re-share), EXPIRED (the hold lapsed and could not be re-booked), RELEASED (dropped from the draft, or released without a reason) or NOT_FOUND (nothing recorded). UNKNOWN means courtscheduler could not be reached and the check failed open; courtscheduler itself never emits it.
